question: Group all rooms into whether or not they are assignable and the major use descriptions. For each group, state "ASSIGNABLE" if the room is assignable and "NON-ASSIGNABLE" otherwise, the major use description, the total number of rooms, total area, and average area. Include subtotals for each group and a grand total across all groups. The assignable status and major use descriptions should only be displayed when they differ from the previous row. Do not include rooms whose major use or major use description starts with 'ZUSE.' The results should be sorted by assignable status and major use description. The subtotal and grand total rows should not include assignable status or major use description.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN mu.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' END AS assign_status,
    mu.DESCRIPTION AS major_use_desc,
    r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY,
    r.AREA
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
  WHERE NOT (mu.MAJOR_USE LIKE 'ZUSE.%' OR mu.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'ZUSE.%')
),
rollup_cte AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(assign_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(major_use_desc) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN GROUPING(major_use_desc) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS row_type,
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(assign_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE assign_status END AS assign_status_sort,
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(major_use_desc) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE major_use_desc END AS major_use_desc_sort,
    assign_status,
    major_use_desc,
    COUNT(FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(AREA) AS total_area,
    AVG(AREA) AS average_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY assign_status, major_use_desc
  WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(assign_status) OVER (ORDER BY assign_status_sort, major_use_desc_sort) = assign_status THEN NULL
    ELSE assign_status
  END AS assign_status,
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(major_use_desc) OVER (ORDER BY assign_status_sort, major_use_desc_sort) = major_use_desc THEN NULL
    ELSE major_use_desc
  END AS major_use_desc,
  total_rooms,
  total_area,
  average_area
FROM rollup_cte
ORDER BY assign_status_sort, major_use_desc_sort

WITH subq1 AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.MAJOR_USE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS a JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND NOT b.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.area_range DESC) SELECT s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s1.BUILDING_NAME, s1.BUILDING_TYPE, s1.hist_record_count, s1.total_assignable_area, s1.avg_hist_num_of_rooms, s2.area_range, s2.area_variance, s2.area_stddev, s2.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS mit_assignable_area FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME = s2.BUILDING_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, fbh.CAMPUS_SECTOR, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT'), access_level_variance AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY access_level_code_sort, campus_sector_sort) = ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE THEN NULL ELSE ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE END AS access_level_code, ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, campus_sector, num_of_rooms_variance, ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE AS join_access_level_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE END AS access_level_code_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE CAMPUS_SECTOR END AS campus_sector, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE CAMPUS_SECTOR END AS campus_sector_sort, ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, MAX(ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME) AS ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, CAMPUS_SECTOR WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY access_level_code_sort, campus_sector_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.AREA FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36'), floor_area_stats AS (SELECT f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(i.AREA) - MIN(i.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(i.AREA) AS area_variance, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE AS join_access_level_code FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS f ON i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG GROUP BY f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) SELECT alv.access_level_code, alv.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, alv.campus_sector, alv.num_of_rooms_variance, fas.FLOOR, fas.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fas.area_range, fas.area_variance FROM access_level_variance AS alv JOIN floor_area_stats AS fas ON alv.join_access_level_code = fas.join_access_level_code ORDER BY alv.access_level_code, alv.campus_sector, fas.FLOOR

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE

WITH RoomAreaCategory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, ROOM, SPACE_ID, AREA, MAJOR_USE, DESCRIPTION, min_area_per_major_use, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, CASE WHEN AREA > min_area_per_major_use * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN AREA < min_area_per_major_use * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_ROOM' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte), MajorUseAvgArea AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT DESCRIPTION, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) SELECT rac.BUILDING_ROOM, rac.FLOOR, rac.ROOM, rac.SPACE_ID, rac.AREA, rac.MAJOR_USE, rac.DESCRIPTION, rac.min_area_per_major_use, rac.room_size_category, mua.avg_area FROM RoomAreaCategory AS rac LEFT JOIN MajorUseAvgArea AS mua ON rac.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mua.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND rac.DESCRIPTION = mua.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY rac.MAJOR_USE

    r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY,

rollup_cte AS (

         SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
